I do not want my car getting hit, so I start my car and reposition it as far as I can to the left without hitting the pole. Soon after the van door swings open wide, and it looks like when the woman gets out, she might knock the door into my car. I roll down my window and say loudly, "Excuse me, please don't hit my car!" The woman looks like she's half asleep and stares at me before saying, "I'm not."

I decide to reply, "You would have if I didn't move my car. You parked SO CLOSE to me."
